clauses.reason: This clause, the whole of Executive Order 11029, terminated on 1986-02-25 when EO 12553 revoked the order by number. Mechanism: express revocation by a numbered list ("Revocation of Various Executive Orders"; "any amendments thereto, are revoked:"); the target is identified by this row: "11029 Amending an order creating a board of inquiry to report on a labor dispute affecting the aircraft". The effective date is the signing date, 1986-02-25 (alternative: publication on 1986-03-03). The order is an executed amendment with no end of its own; the earlier candidate described in the research rationale is disclosed and is not an end for the reasons stated there.

savings.reason: After a bounded search of the full text of EO 12553, the U.S. Code and eCFR (no hits for this order) and the Federal Register catalog notes, no savings clause, exception or surviving legal effect of this amending order was found; EO 12553 revokes it without reservation.
